features.name: Life Domain Spells
features.description: Your connection to the positive energy of life grants you spells that are always prepared and don't count against the number of spells you can prepare.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.description: Whenever a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature regains additional Hit Points equal to 2 plus the spell slot's level.

features.name: Preserve Life
features.description: As a Magic action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to restore a number of Hit Points equal to five times your Cleric level, divided as you choose among creatures within 30 feet of you. You can restore a creature to no more than half its Hit Point maximum this way, and you can't use it on an Undead or a Construct.

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.description: The healing spells you cast on others heal you as well. When you cast a spell with a spell slot that restores Hit Points to one or more creatures other than yourself, you regain Hit Points equal to 2 plus the spell slot's level.

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.description: When you would normally roll one or more dice to restore Hit Points to a creature with a spell or with Channel Divinity: Preserve Life, you instead use the highest number possible for each die. For example, instead of restoring 2d6 Hit Points, you restore 12.
